summary: Final readout of the AP02 hERG channel screen and 5-isoform CYP panel. The lipophilic branch carries an ion-channel liability and Avernelwick advanced the more polar analogues.

slides.title: AP02 hinge-binder triage: paired safety screen
Study scope and plate acceptance
bullets: {{PRJ0001:n_compounds}} analogues; hERG automated patch clamp and 5-isoform CYP panel.
Test period 12–27 Sep 2011; sample cards linked to {{PRJ0001:lims_id}}.
Ravi Deshmukh checked cell-level fits; Ines Alvarado checked the run sheets before release.
E-4031 control IC50 {{PRJ0001:herg.control_e4031_nM}} nM; accepted for interpretation.

slides.title: Controls and reporting rules
bullets: CYP3A4 control {{PRJ0001:cyp.control_CYP3A4_uM}} µM; historical reference {{PRJ0001:cyp.hist_CYP3A4_uM}} µM.
CYP2D6 control {{PRJ0001:cyp.control_CYP2D6_uM}} µM; historical reference {{PRJ0001:cyp.hist_CYP2D6_uM}} µM.
hERG upper concentration {{PRJ0001:herg.top_conc_uM}} µM; greater-than values remain censored.
Flagged hERG entries: {{PRJ0001:herg.n_flagged}}. Retain cell counts and plate acceptance notes when ranking.

slides.title: hERG interpretation
bullets: {{PRJ0001:herg.n_1_10uM}} compounds in the 1–10 µM band; {{PRJ0001:herg.n_ge_10uM}} at or above 10 µM.
The lipophilic branch carries the ion-channel liability; prefer the more polar analogues at this screen gate.
These measurements do not establish an exposure-based safety margin.

slides.title: AP02 representatives for the chemistry discussion
slides.notes: Representative structures identify the screening set; this grid is not a potency ranking.

slides.title: Progression decision and handover
bullets: Avernelwick advanced the more polar analogues; deprioritise the lipophilic branch.
Any CYP isoform above 50% inhibition at 10 µM: {{PRJ0001:cyp.n_any_gt50}} compounds; CYP3A4 is most frequently flagged.
Cross-check the chosen analogue against both complete assay listings, retaining censored and flagged hERG results.
Dr A. Veldershain to carry the paired ranking into the biology memo; the single-concentration CYP panel does not establish mechanism.
